value.absent_semantics: ABSENT IS ABSENT, NEVER ZERO. A 0.0 is a MEASURED statement of no affinity; ABSENT is the statement that nothing was measured. Coercing the ABSENT entities to 0.0 would move the metric domain off the ruled both-measured C(1337,2) and onto the full union, silently, while every number still printed a denominator.

value.six_three_number_semantics: ROC-AUC of W_P scored against the same-firm label, over the both-measured pair domain. It is 1.0 EXACTLY AND TAUTOLOGICALLY: the score IS the label. This number is printed because the cell requires it printed, and it is labelled NOT A RESULT because a perfect score obtained by scoring a label against itself measures nothing.

evidence.instrument: Mann-Whitney identity for ROC-AUC. Positives all score 1, negatives all score 0, so every comparison is concordant by construction.
evidence.why_a_shuffle_control_cannot_falsify_thi: Permuting the firm labels leaves the same-firm pair COUNT unchanged, because shuffling permutes labels without changing block sizes. So a size-based control is structurally incapable of falsifying this number. The tautology lives in the IDENTITY of score and label, which is exactly what this cell asks to be TYPED rather than reported as a finding. Naming the control that does NOT work is the honest form.

evidence.IT_IS_A_FRAME_NOT_A_DISCOUNT: The sweep's AUC is a ROC-AUC over pairs, and ROC-AUC is INVARIANT TO CLASS PREVALENCE by construction: it ranks within each class and the positive:negative ratio cancels. A near-balanced P therefore does NOT inflate its AUC. NO ROW MAY DEFLATE A P RESULT BY THIS FRACTION. PR-AUC would be prevalence-sensitive; this is not.
